visual_review.observations: Reused public IEM ASOS observations: 13 stations per reviewed hour; surface temperature, dewpoint and wind speed. No historical observed radar grid.
reflectivity: 13 UTC: broad Georgia/Florida/Atlantic systems agree; Florida Gulf-coast strong cells are displaced and a few Great Lakes cells differ.
14 UTC: the GPU has a stronger individual coastal South Carolina cell; Atlantic and Florida cores differ while broad placement agrees.
15 UTC: native has a stronger local coastal Carolina core and the GPU has a weaker south Florida core; main Georgia/Atlantic bands agree.
